name: Loriss
source:
Loriss was the leader of the Ban Ardor Fell until the Fell leadership moved to Ban Ardor to work for the [url=https://vndb.org/c165570]MC[/url]. Loriss is a talented administrator, who has a fascination with alchemy. Loriss steps up to command the Fell when [url=https://vndb.org/c165574]Lydia[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c165607]Desiree[/url] are unavailable.
